info.name: MicroService API
info.description:
Importable collection for the MicroService REST framework (CodeIgniter 4). Bearer API-key auth is set at the collection level so every request — and any n8n HTTP Request node modelled on these — inherits it. Set the `baseUrl` and `apiKey` collection variables (or import the matching environment) before sending.

**Auth**
- All `/api/v1/*` endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <prefix>.<secret>` EXCEPT `health` (open).
- Mint a key on the server: `php spark key:create --name n8n --scopes products:read,products:write` (the key is shown once). Paste it into the `apiKey` variable.
- Scopes are `{resource}:{action}` with action ∈ read/write/delete; wildcards `products:*`, `*:read`, `*`.
- Missing/invalid key → 401; valid key without the needed scope → 403 (both neutral problem+json).

**Contract**
- Success: `{ "data": ..., "meta": ... }` (`meta` omitted when empty; collections carry `meta.pagination`).
- Errors: RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` (`{type,title,status,detail?,requestId,errors?}`).
- Every response carries an `X-Request-Id` (echoed, or supply your own to correlate an n8n run).
- Writes must send `Content-Type: application/json` (else 415) with valid JSON (else 400).
- **Rate limiting:** per-key fixed window; every response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit` / `X-RateLimit-Remaining`; exceeding it returns **429** with `Retry-After`. Set a per-key limit with `key:create --rate-limit N`.
- Every request is recorded server-side (`api_request_log`) and stamps the key's `last_used_at`.
- Responses deliberately carry **no** PHP/CodeIgniter/Apache fingerprints.

**Resources** are config-driven: `products` is the sample. Run **Create product** first — its test script stores the new id into `productId`, which the Get/Update/Delete requests reuse.

header.description: Optional correlation id (echoed back). Remove to let the service mint one.

request.description: Liveness/readiness probe. Pings the external database; `{data:{status,service,time,checks}}`. 200 healthy, 503 degraded. Unauthenticated.
Shows the neutral error shape: unknown paths return RFC 9457 problem+json with no engine disclosure. The same shape is returned for every error status.

Self-description of the API: every registered resource with its endpoint, output fields, writable fields, sortable/filterable columns, supported operators, and pagination caps. Will be auth-gated once auth lands.

item.name: Products
item.description: CRUD for the sample `products` resource (generic config-driven engine).

query.description: Prefix '-' for descending. Only whitelisted columns: sku, name, price, created_at.
Operators: eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, in. Only filterable columns: sku, status, price.

request.description: Filtering and sparse fieldsets are allow-listed and parameter-bound. Unknown columns/operators/fields return 400 problem+json.
Creates a product. 201 + `Location` header. Validation errors return 422 problem+json with a per-field `errors` map.
Fetch one product by id. Unknown id → neutral 404 problem+json.
Partial update (PATCH) or full replace (PUT). Only fillable fields are accepted; others are ignored.
Archival delete: the row is moved to the recycle bin (not destroyed) and audited. 204 No Content. Restore it via Audit & recycle bin → Restore archived record.

item.name: Audit & recycle bin
item.description: Inspect the audit trail and the recycle bin; restore deleted rows. Needs scopes audit:read / archive:read / archive:write.

request.description: Lists archived (deleted) rows. Requires scope archive:read.
Shows one archived record including its full payload. Requires scope archive:read.
Re-inserts the row into its original table. Requires scope archive:write. 409 if already restored or the original id is taken.

query.description: Optional: filter by a single record id.

request.description: Every create/update/delete/restore with before/after snapshots and changed-field list. Requires scope audit:read.
